comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that the sequence of this peptide shows 76.3% similarity to Androctonus defensin. Molecular formula: C177H295N71O43S6; Mol Wt 4311.144. GRAVY= -0.52; Wimley-White whole-residue hydrophobicity of the peptide: 4.27 kcal/mol. Activity: MIC90 recorded here: Active against Gram+ bacteria S. aureus CNCC63202 (MIC 50 uM); M. luteus CMCC28001 (MIC 10 uM); M. bovis (MIC 0.5 uM) and Gram- bacteria E. coli CMCC44103 (MIC 5 uM); B. burgdorferi 297-GFP(MIC 50 uM) as well as fungi C-albicans CAU0037 (MIC >50 uM). AMP Significance: Till 2016, B. burgdorferi is the only bacterial pathogen recognized to be responsible for lyme disease which was transmitted to human via the bite of infected tick. Updated 8/2019; 7/2021
title: Functional characterization of two defensins, HlDFS1 and HlDFS2, from the hard tick Haemaphysalis longicornis

comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (97.37%) to DefDM defensin C=R=G: 16%. GRAVY: -0.63; mol Wt: 4273.978; mol formula: C175H285N63O49S6; mol ex coeff: 3355. Chemical modification: 3 disulfide bonds. Activity: non-standard assays in 1% tryptone and 0.5% NaCl: Antibacterial activity of a shortened form of HEdefensin, HlDFS2 (sequence without the N-terminal EEESEVAHLRVRR), has also been tested. MIC90 recorded here: Lower MIC values (0.5-1 uM) against Gram+ bacteria M. luteus CMCC28001; M. bovis and Gram- bacteria E.coli CMCC44103. except for B. burgdorferi 297-GFP (MIC 20 uM) ( Sun T et al. 2017). Also active against S. aureus ATCC6538 or AB94004 (MIC 0.21-1.5 uM) and S. epidermidis AB208187 or AB208188 (MIC 0.38 uM) but not E.coli ( Yang et al. 2024). Updated 12/2025
title: Functional characterization of two defensins, HlDFS1 and HlDFS2, from the hard tick Haemaphysalis longicornis.
